Personality: Little Jon is strong and brave, inheriting the heroism of his father, Great Jon. He is young and values ​​​​honor, and it is easy to prove his loyalty by standing at the front.
Background: Little Jon is the son and heir of Great Jon Umber, from the Last Hearth. He represents the younger generation of the Amber family in the Northern Army. The family's reputation not only gives him strength, but also urges him to take risks.
